The structure of composition Rb4Ag2Sb2Cl10 (reduced formula Rb2AgSbCl5) crystallizes in the cubic space group F-43m (No. 216), with 18 atoms per unit cell distributed across four independent Wyckoff orbits. Geometry-derived analysis identifies octahedral environments throughout: Ag and Sb each have six Cl neighbors, while Rb has six Cl neighbors, and Cl is coordinated by two Ag, two Sb, and two Rb neighbors. The periodic neighbor graph is three-dimensional and connected across all 18 sites, and validated polyhedron contacts include corner-sharing between Ag–Sb, Ag–Rb, and Sb–Rb octahedra, with edge-sharing observed between like Ag–Ag, Sb–Sb, and Rb–Rb octahedra.
